department: Faculty of Science — Department of Earth and Environmental Sciences

deadline.value: Direct regular CUHK admission deadline for MPhil and PhD programmes is January 31, 2027 (HKPFS deadline is December 1, 2026; departmental review begins around December 2, 2026).
deadline.quote: 31 January 2027 (For applicants who apply for MPhil programme and PhD programme directly with CUHK).

gre_subject.value: ETS offers GRE Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology (none in this field).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: EES postgraduate admission page does not state a pre-application supervisor contact requirement.

funding.value: Postgraduate studentship for MPhil-PhD students is HK$19,100/month (HK$229,200/yr in GS schedule; applications submitted after January 31, 2027 may not be considered for financial support).
funding.quote: Applications submitted after 31 January 2027 may not be considered for financial support.

also.quote: Annual studentship for 2026-27 is HK$229,200 (approx. US$29,400). Payable during the normative period of study.

entry_route.value: Articulated MPhil-PhD programme admits both bachelor's holders (direct to pre-candidacy PhD or MPhil stream) and master's holders.
entry_route.quote: Articulated MPhil-PhD programmes provide a pathway for students with a Bachelor's degree to pursue a PhD. Initially, students are admitted as either MPhil students or pre-candidacy PhD students.

notes: Department of Earth and Environmental Sciences (formerly Earth System Science) sets a January 31, 2027 regular CUHK deadline while starting review around December 2, 2026 and maintaining December 1, 2026 for HKPFS.
